Description
Topics to be discussed include conics, parametric equations, polar coordinates, vectors in the plane and three dimensional space, multivariable calculus; chain rules, implicit functions, change of variables in multiple integrals; limits, continuity, and differentiability.Not open to students who have completed MTH 3030, or MTH 3050.
